amount.description: Backend phải kiểm giá trị >0 khi là thanh toán/hoàn tiền. Giá bán có thể 0 chỉ khi policy cho phép.

ShopPatch.description: PATCH partial: omitted fields remain unchanged. Explicit null clears only nullable fields. If a collection field is supplied, its full allowed editable collection replaces that field under If-Match. Server validates merged state and same-shop references.

ProductWrite.description: Create product; variants may not reference existing entities from another product/shop. Updates use ProductWritePatch. If variants is supplied in patch it is a complete editable collection; known variants retain IDs, new variants omit ID. Removing an existing variant archives it, preserving order and inventory history; server rejects removal with active reservations or nonzero stock.
